drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂碳点通过非催化位点结合溶菌酶，抑制其淀粉样纤维化并重塑构象。

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本患者对仑卡奈单抗的获益期望远超实际疗效，临床需全程管理该落差。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-突触核蛋白与tau免疫治疗失败揭示四大教训，指明AD联合免疫策略新方向。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 系统性与脑衰弱决定抗淀粉样治疗获益，超越淀粉样蛋白本身。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体凭借血脑屏障穿透力与多靶点载药优势，成为超越现有抗淀粉样疗法的阿尔茨海默病新策略。

drug.title: Cerebral amyloid-β burden and white matter injury: associations, clues for underlying mechanisms, and implication on cognitive trajectory after lecanemab therapy.
drug.zh: 仑卡奈单抗疗效受基线白质损伤影响，Aβ负荷或经特定通路驱动WMH进展。

drug.title: A Metabolomics-Based Strategy for Identifying Endogenous Inhibitors of IAPP Aggregation.
drug.zh: 代谢组学筛选出内源性代谢物可抑制IAPP聚集，为糖尿病相关淀粉样病变提供新干预靶点。

drug.title: Donanemab for early symptomatic AD in the UK-indicated population: safety and efficacy in those who are non-carriers or heterozygous for APOE ε4.
drug.zh: 英国适用人群中，多奈单抗使ARIA-E风险升至20.8%，但疗效获益仍明确。

mech.title: Stepwise Upregulation of Microglial Genes through the Slow Progression of Amyloid Pathology in Alzheimer's Disease Model Mice.
mech.zh: 小胶质细胞基因随淀粉样病理缓慢进展呈阶梯式激活，而非渐进上调。

mech.title: Glucose hypometabolism gates tau-dependent necroptosis.
mech.zh: 葡萄糖低代谢解除A20保护并协同磷酸化tau激活RIPK1，驱动神经元坏死性凋亡。

mech.title: Context-dependent roles of osteopontin in aging-related neurological disorders.
mech.journal: The Journal of international medical res
mech.zh: 骨桥蛋白在衰老相关神经疾病中兼具促炎损伤与修复保护的双重角色，作用取决于细胞来源及疾病阶段。

mech.title: An analysis of cerebral amyloid angiopathy based on samples from human brain bank.
mech.zh: 基于人脑库样本发现脑淀粉样血管病与阿尔茨海默病病理改变显著相关，并揭示其亚型转录组差异。

mech.title: Multi-omics integration identifies APOE as a metabolic regulator of macrophage-fibroblast crosstalk in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
mech.zh: 多组学与孟德尔随机化揭示APOE通过调控巨噬-成纤维细胞互作介导阿尔茨海默病与肺纤维化的共同遗传机制。

mech.title: Phage Display In Vivo: Protocols for Identifying Brain-Targeting Peptides in Mouse Models of Neurodegeneration.
mech.zh: 活体噬菌体展示技术可精准筛选靶向正常及神经退行性脑组织的肽段。

mech.title: Hepatic-targeted low-intensity pulsed ultrasound attenuates cerebral amyloidosis via upregulating insulin-degrading enzyme.
mech.zh: 肝脏靶向低强度脉冲超声通过上调IDE改善外周代谢并减轻脑内Aβ病理。

mech.title: Phosphatidylethanolamine-mediated metabolic membrane remodeling in obesity-associated Alzheimer's disease: mechanisms, neuroimmune crosstalk, and therapeutic potential.
mech.zh: 肥胖相关阿尔茨海默病中磷脂酰乙醇胺介导的代谢性膜重塑是核心机制与治疗靶点。

dx.title: From amyloid PET to plasma biomarkers: A multimodal imaging framework for early diagnosis and staging of Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆生物标志物联合多模态影像，可实现AD早期精准诊断与分期。

dx.title: Longitudinal Dynamics of the Blood Proteome Within the Alzheimer Spectrum in Down Syndrome.
dx.zh: 唐氏综合征患者阿尔茨海默病进展中，9种血浆蛋白纵向轨迹揭示其病理与认知衰退关联。

dx.title: Model-based ordering of the ALPS index among Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
dx.zh: ALPS指数介于血浆Aβ42/40改变与淀粉样PET阳性之间，先于tau相关生物标志物。

dx.title: Brain-derived plasma p-tau217 shows enhanced dynamic range for Alzheimer's disease neuropathological change.
dx.zh: 脑源性p-tau217血浆标志物动态范围更宽，可更精准反映AD神经病理变化。

dx.title: Machine learning for the prediction of amyloid PET positivity using plasma biomarkers, cognition, APOE genotype, and structural imaging.
dx.zh: 多模态机器学习整合血浆与影像指标可精准预测阿尔茨海默病淀粉样PET阳性状态。

dx.title: Female vulnerability to microvascular transport dysfunction emerges early across the Alzheimer's disease continuum.
dx.zh: 女性在阿尔茨海默病极早期即出现微血管运输功能障碍，且早于脑血流下降。

dx.title: Association Between Alzheimer Pathology, Sleep, and Cognition in Patients With Late-Onset Unexplained Epilepsy.
dx.zh: 晚发不明原因癫痫患者中，血浆p-tau217升高与认知下降相关，且该效应部分由睡眠慢波活动减少介导。

dx.title: Longitudinal plasma phosphorylated tau217 classification and the association with Alzheimer's disease progression.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217基线阈值可稳定预测Aβ-PET阳性及AD进展，中间区带人群转阳风险高。

prev.title: Cross-sectional associations of loneliness with plasma p-tau217 and neurofilament light chain in dementia-free older adults in the INSPIRE-T baseline cohort.
prev.zh: 孤独感与痴呆前老年人血浆p-tau217及NfL水平升高独立相关。

prev.title: Robust inference and correlates from genetic associations with personality.
prev.zh: 遗传关联分析揭示大五人格的稳健遗传位点及跨人群普适性。

prev.title: Response to Interpreting "intermittent" psychological distress in dementia research: A classification that obscures more than it reveals.
prev.zh: 该文批判将痴呆患者心理困扰简单归类为“间歇性”的做法，认为此分类掩盖了重要信息。

prev.title: Exploratory factor and network analysis of 43 inflammatory plasma biomarkers and cognitive performance in Black adults.
prev.zh: 黑人血浆43种炎症因子经因子网络分析，其特定组合与认知表现显著相关。

prev.title: Multi-trajectories of activity participation and risk of mild cognitive impairment in China: A national longitudinal cohort study.
prev.zh: 中国老年人多活动轨迹中，持续高参与体力、社交及智力活动可显著降低轻度认知障碍风险。

prev.title: A One-Year Study Using Digital Biomarkers From Sensing Technologies to Assess Changes in Physical Activity Levels and Sleep Quality in Nursing Home Residents With Dementia: Observational Study.
prev.zh: 数字生物标志物可长期稳定监测痴呆患者活动与睡眠变化，优于传统问卷。

prev.title: Speech-in-Noise Hearing Impairment and Incident Dementia: A UK Biobank Cohort Study Across Polygenic, APOE ε4, and Familial Risk Strata.
prev.zh: 噪声下言语识别障碍独立预测痴呆风险，且不受遗传易感性分层影响。

prev.title: SoUth Korean study to PrEvent cognitive impaiRment and protect BRAIN health via Behavioral, Optimized, Organized Movement therapy (SUPERBRAIN-BOOM) in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Protocol for a Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Feasibility Trial.
prev.zh: 韩国启动SUPERBRAIN-BOOM试验，以舞蹈运动为核心验证MCI多域干预可行性。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞造出“迷你人脑”来研究老年痴呆，帮我们搞清病因、试新药，让未来治疗更靠谱。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用一滴血查几个关键蛋白，就能更早、更便宜地发现老年痴呆风险，不用再做又贵又疼的腰穿检查。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工（小胶质细胞）一旦吃坏油、变懒散，就会加速老年痴呆，搞清这点能帮咱们找新药、早预防。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好可能增加将来痴呆风险，早调理睡眠、护好大脑，是咱能主动抓住的防病机会。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑病的最新临床试验，结论是安全可行，但效果还在验证中，普通人了解即可。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 一种叫“甘特单抗”的新药，对早期老年痴呆效果还不确定，这篇研究帮大家看清它到底有没有用、安不安全。

intro.title: Distinct roles of AMPA receptor subunits as potential therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里负责记忆的“信号开关”出了故障会得老年痴呆，科学家正研究怎么精准修复它，帮患者延缓记性变差。

intro.title: Peroxynitrite: A potential therapeutic target for Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，一种叫“过氧亚硝酸盐”的坏分子在老年痴呆里捣乱，科学家正研究怎么拦住它，未来可能帮上大忙。
